summary: Love, for you, comes with weight. You take it seriously, maybe too seriously. Affection can feel like something to earn, or something that might be taken away.
body: Love, for you, comes with weight. You take it seriously, maybe too seriously. Affection can feel like something to earn, or something that might be taken away. This can make love feel serious, earned, or tied to conditions. As an adult you may hold back, choose duty over warmth, or feel unworthy of the easy kind of love. The work is letting yourself receive without first proving you deserve it.
gift: At your best: loyal, committed, the one who actually stays.
shadow: The trap: rationing affection, or believing love has to be earned to be real.
integration: Let love and values and discipline and limits cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Loyal and hardworking; the risk is joyless striving and a belief that reward must be suffered for.
do: Let yourself receive without earning it
Choose warmth over duty on purpose
Name the fear that love will be withdrawn
dont: Wait to feel worthy before you let love in
